decisions.reason: As the publicly announced flagship of the firm's innovative direction, it carries the highest sunk costs and public commitment, so management will persist rather than drop it now.
With its own webpage and multiple models, the spill-retention pallet line has substantial investment and visibility, so escalation of commitment supports keeping it.
Though less sunk investment and less central than the product lines, its public commitment still makes management reluctant to drop it, albeit with a higher risk than the others.
